FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 49 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines; and could increase the obligations of the district attorneys by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offense provided by this bill.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
